title: Bicol-Style Fish Fry
description: A Filipino-inspired fish dish with a spicy kick, made by pan-frying fish in a mixture of coconut milk and chili peppers.

ingredients.name: Chili peppers (siling labuyo or Thai chili)
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for spice level

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground for best flavor

instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Season the fish with salt and black pepper.
3. Add the garlic to the pan and sauté for 1 minute.
4. Add the chili peppers to the pan and sauté for another minute.
5. Add the coconut milk to the pan and stir well.
6. Add the fish to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
7. Remove the fish from the pan and serve hot.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
